findings.title: Report queue flush/queue race can silently lose queued reports
Operator detection uses the default SIM, not the data SIM the spec mandates
Failover tears the tunnel down between candidates - kill-switch leak window
HTTP errors defeat the verified-cache fallback in bundle fetch
TUN fd set to blocking mode - unverified risk
Spec 8.4 post-connect health monitoring and mid-session failover absent
Shared SimpleDateFormat and unsynchronized log-file appends in AppLog
App data is backup-eligible by default
Candidate records cross to the service via Intent extras (Binder size ceiling)
startForegroundService called from a background thread after the fetch window
Ed25519 verifier performs no small-order/subgroup check on decoded points
Core debug messages are written verbatim to the persistent app log
Core-boundary discipline drift; throwaway core object in Settings
GPL-3.0 obligations of the embedded libbox are undecided - blocks distribution
Release build unconfigured: no minify, no signing, arm64-v8a only
Interface enumeration does not exclude the app's own TUN interface

inspected_paths: src/main/java/autoconnect/app/*.kt (15 files, 1873 lines, read in full)
